grn.text: Leighbet loses her Izzet position after a daring experiment goes wrong and sets up an unsanctioned lab, where she recruits Tamsyn Sweene to assist her.

Their serum, made from rift plant samples, makes a lab mouse completely impervious to electricity, and Tamsyn convinces her that the five test subjects must be silenced, so she poisons them with a lethal sleep elixir and Leighbet goes along with it.
Desperate for money, Leighbet signs up for paid experiments and is transformed by Simic biomancers into a clawed, fanged monster, and she flees into the sewers.

There Tamsyn reveals that she is a shapeshifting Dimir spy who never was a blastseeker, and Leighbet kills her by snapping her spine before returning to her laboratory, vowing to protect her discoveries.
